attchmntText: UFLEX Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: UFLEX Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its earnings conference call held on November 16, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST. The recording is available on the company website at https://www.uflexltd.com/quarterly-earnings-reports.php. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement was signed by Ritesh Chaudhry, Senior Vice President (Secretarial) and Company Secretary.

attchmntText: UFLEX Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: UFlex Limited submitted a revised earnings presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27 to the NSE and BSE on November 16, 2026. The revised document supersedes the earlier submission. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 26.1% year-on-year to Rs. 48,694 million. Normalized EBITDA increased 94.8% to Rs. 7,588 million with a margin of 15.6%. Normalized PAT rose 682.8% to Rs. 2,106 million. For H1 FY27, revenue grew 31.9% to Rs. 102,666 million. Normalized EBITDA increased 85.7% to Rs. 15,961 million. Normalized PAT grew 646.5% to Rs. 6,340 million. Sales volumes rose 1.5% to 163,532 metric tons. Total capex for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 5,689 million, bringing cumulative H1 capex to Rs. 10,471 million. The Noida recycling project was commissioned on May 1, 2026.

attchmntText: UFLEX Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: UFLEX Limited filed an earnings presentation for its Q2 and H1 FY27 results on November 16, 2026. Consolidated revenue grew 26.1% year-on-year to Rs. 48,694 million in Q2 FY27. Normalized EBITDA increased 94.8% to Rs. 7,588 million, with margins expanding to 15.6%. Normalized PAT rose 682.8% to Rs. 2,106 million. For H1 FY27, revenue grew 31.9% to Rs. 102,666 million, and normalized EBITDA increased 85.7% to Rs. 15,961 million. Net profit for H1 FY27 grew 646.5% to Rs. 6,340 million. Sales volumes rose 1.5% to 163,532 metric tons. The company incurred Rs. 5,689 million in capital expenditure during Q2 FY27, bringing cumulative H1 capex to Rs. 10,471 million. The Noida recycling project was commissioned on May 1, 2026.
